messages:
raj_sales: Quick heads-up — HeliosBank POC starts next week. They insist on a private connectivity pattern. Asking which we recommend: VPC Peering/TGW vs PrivateLink. Also need explicit firewall rules (SGs/NACLs) and any pricing/latency tradeoffs. Demo planned Tue, can we confirm?

anna_s: For a finance customer who wants strict isolation, my default recommendation is PrivateLink with a dedicated endpoint + mTLS. Peering/TGW gives lower hop count and simpler egress but requires route table and cross-account route maintenance. PrivateLink simplifies customer network policy (they only need SG rules to the interface endpoint). :thumbsup:

matt_se: Perf note — PrivateLink adds an extra hop (NLB) but it's usually fine unless you need sub-50ms tail latency. Throughput is fine for moderate loads. Also watch AWS charges: PrivateLink has per-GB and per-hour components. TGW/peering avoids interface-hour charges but may incur cross-AZ data fees.

elio_infra: For firewall allowlist guidance: avoid relying on ephemeral NLB IPs. Recommend allowing outbound 443 to our service DNS name (redwood-priv-prod.<region>.privatelink.aws) or to published egress CIDRs if they need static IPs. For Dedicated engagements we can allocate static egress ranges: e.g., 3.34.56.0/24 and 34.120.12.0/24 (example ranges we publish in the one-pager).

kate_security: On security Qs: we support TLS1.2+; mTLS is supported for Private deployments and PrivateLink if they present a client cert at the proxy. We'll mark the security questionnaire item for mutual auth as 'supported with configuration'. We also provide audit logs for Private installs.

raj_sales: Can you paste the minimal SG/NACL rules I should send the customer? They run strict NACLs (deny by default).

matt_se: Minimal SG (PrivateLink): outbound TCP 443 to the Interface Endpoint (use the endpoint's SG or DNS name). If using peering/TGW: allow outbound TCP 443 to service subnet (e.g., 10.10.5.0/24) and ephemeral return ports (1024-65535) for TCP. NACLs: allow port 443 ingress/egress between their app subnets and the endpoint/peered subnet.

anna_s: Important SNI note: our shared endpoints rely on SNI to route to the correct tenant service. If they terminate TLS at a proxy and do NOT forward SNI, we recommend a dedicated endpoint (or pass Host header/SNI through). If they can't pass SNI, we can provision a customer-specific endpoint.

networking_bot: FYI — PrivateLink endpoint acceptance required for our endpoint-service unless auto-accept is enabled. For POC we can toggle auto-accept to speed things up; ops approval needed.

elio_infra: Quick pricing estimates for sales to quote (ballpark for POC): PrivateLink: ~ $0.05/hr for endpoint + ~$0.01/GB data processing. Peering/TGW: no endpoint-hours but standard AZ data transfer costs apply. We will attach exact numbers to the formal quote.

raj_sales: Great — they asked for a one-pager with recommended option, SG/NACL snippets, and test steps. Can someone draft? They want the recommendation for a finance customer (strict isolation, moderate throughput).

anna_s: I'll draft the one-pager. Recommendation: PrivateLink with dedicated endpoint + mTLS. POC steps I will include: 1) Customer creates Interface Endpoint in their VPC (share vpce ID), 2) We accept/confirm endpoint and map to their tenant, 3) Customer adds SG rule: outbound TCP 443 to the endpoint SG / DNS, 4) Customer runs test curl w/ SNI and optional client cert, 5) We monitor in Console and collect logs.

matt_se: Test curl snippet to include in doc: ```curl --cert client.pem --key client.key -H 'Host: redwood-priv-prod' https://vpce-0123abcd.us-west-2.vpce.amazonaws.com/status``` Use Host header/SNI to hit the right virtual service.

kate_security: I'll draft the security answers for the questionnaire: data in transit AES-256/TLS, mTLS supported, audit logs available, key management via KMS/HSM for Private.

raj_sales: Timeline: I'll propose Tues demo but will slide to Wed if we need endpoint acceptance/config. Thanks everyone.

anna_s: Sending the one-pager and sample SG/NACLs to the customer email thread now. Will cc you, raj. :rocket:

networking_bot: Created ticket INF-4921 to publish POC egress CIDRs and track acceptance toggle.
